evals.expected_output: A root AGENTS.md grounded in manifests, CI, tests, and existing docs, with verified commands and no generic filler.

evals.prompt: Audit our existing AGENTS.md against https://agents.md/ and fix only material problems. It currently duplicates most of README and includes several commands that may be stale.

evals.prompt: This monorepo already has a root AGENTS.md. Add agent guidance for packages/payments only if that subtree genuinely needs separate instructions, and avoid contradicting the root file.
evals.expected_output: An evidence-based placement decision and, when justified, compatible nested guidance limited to payments-specific commands and constraints.
